M5.4 and M5.6 require grants, tenant scope, digest-bound approvals and revocation before execution/resume.
M5.1/M5.2/M5.3 define fencing, restart, retry, dead-letter and stale-write boundaries.
M5.5/M5.8 make budget and observability first-class before scale-up; no paid/model route is admitted.

resolved_gaps: separated approval invalidation from scheduler cancellation
made checkpoint exact-version binding a prerequisite for resume/fork
forbade raw reasoning as trace evidence
made budget stop terminal rather than a retryable fallback
required no shared mutable context for parallel branches

security owner validates capability, tenant/privacy and redaction policy
human approval is design-only and cannot admit provider/Evidence/Writer/full-chain
